arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Yalowitz argued the U.S. can respond to terror abroad. He noted criminal prosecution would not violate due process.
Mr. Berger argued the PSJVTA fails the due process test. He cited the Bauxites standard for legal submission.
Mr. Kneedler argued the statute is integral to national security. He stated it secures compensation for terrorism victims.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether Congress can force foreign entities to pay terrorism judgments. The PSJVTA targets the PLO and PA. the sides that brought the case say this violates due process. the opposing sides say it protects U.S. citizens.
